data.summary:
Result-driven Project Manager with extensive experience in delivering technology programs across the space of Artificial Intelligence and digital business transformation. Proven track record of leading cross-functional global teams, managing $5M+ budgets, and executing 15+ projects across payments, finance, healthcare and core banking. Skilled in Agile and Waterfall methodologies, stakeholder engagement, and digital transformation.
Publicis Groupe - Amazon	Apr’24 – Sep’25
Project Manager Key Responsibilities
Managed cross-functional delivery teams and vendor partners, ensuring adherence to timelines, scope, and budget in high-impact transformation initiatives.
Owned project planning, execution, and monitoring—developed detailed work plans, tracked progress, and adapted milestones to mitigate risks and ensure business outcomes.
Oversaw enterprise-level release planning and execution, representing the project team in multiple forums and ensuring smooth deployment with minimal operational disruption.
Led effective stakeholder communication across business, tech, and vendor teams,drove alignment through regular updates, steering committees, and escalation handling
Built strong stakeholder relationships
Optimized resource allocation across workstreams, improving delivery efficiency and maximizing productivity.
Spearheaded risk identification and mitigation planning throughout the project lifecycle to maintain delivery quality and avoid delays.
Delivered high-quality outcomes by effectively driving collaboration between internal teams, product owners, and technology leads.
Set up the technical team of 60 members and delivered a high-risk project covering several countries, reaching one lac plus users
Agile Implementation: Spearheaded the successful implementation of Agile practice across multiple high-value projects totaling $3M, resulting in improved collaboration, faster delivery cycles, and enhanced adaptability to changing requirements, resulting in a 35% improvement in sprint velocity and team productivity.
This transformation championed a culture of continuous improvement and iterative delivery, reducing rework and increasing customer value
Aligned Cross-Functional Teams: Resolved interdepartmental misalignment by initiating collaborative workshops, introducing a RAID log for risk and dependency tracking, and establishing a shared RACI matrix. Weekly syncs enhanced transparency, reduced conflicts, and ensured unified execution—resulting in smoother delivery and improved project governance.
Freelancer	Jan’23 – Mar’24
Principal Program Manager Project: eCommerce Website Key Responsibilities
Led end-to-end delivery of eCommerce platforms (Shopify)
Managed cross-functional teams including developers, designers, and testers to ensure timely and quality delivery.
Oversaw integration of payment gateways, inventory systems, and logistics tools, enhancing operational efficiency.
Delivered measurable results including an increase in online sales, reduced cart abandonment, and improved customer experience.
Facilitated post-launch support, analytics setup, and continuous improvement strategies.
Marlabs – Client Goldman Sachs	Apr’21 – Jan’23
Technical Project Manager Key Responsibilities
Directed high-value projects of $6M project and program delivery in a global Digital Automation Center of Excellence CoE , aligned with Goldman Sachs objectives.
Led program initiatives leveraging artificial intelligence, robotics automation, digital transformation, and machine learning technologies.
Oversaw the execution of solutions encompassing Chatbots, Intelligent Document Processing IDP , and Robotic Process Automation RPA .
Ensured strict adherence to project plans, budgets, timelines, status reporting, issue resolution, testing protocols, and compliance standards.
Created project charters, Gantt charts, and Work Breakdown Structures WBS , incorporating business cases, objectives, and success metrics.
Anticipated potential obstacles, managed escalations, and reconciled business needs with technical demands effectively.
Improved project testing strategy by implementing a standardized process.
Bolstered the project's risk posture by proactively identifying vulnerabilities and implementing a series of remediation plans.
Initiated and managed Change Requests to accommodate shifting priorities without impacting project deadlines or deliverables.
Nagarro – Client WorldBank	Jan’20 – Sep’20
Delivery Manager Key Responsibilities
Oversaw delivery, fostered team synergy, and implemented optimized software cycles.
Directed digital delivery for a US financial client, integrating DevOps, Agile practices, AI/ML, RPA, automation, and analytics solutions.
Maintained cohesive relationships between delivery teams, product owners, and essential external stakeholders. Managed the complete software development lifecycle, from initial story authoring through task prioritization and scope management.
Monitored project progress to guarantee on-time and accurate delivery of all deliverables, effectively managing potential delays and risks.
Accelerated project timelines by implementing CI/CD pipelines, reducing deployment times.
JP Morgan Chase India	May’14 – Jan’20
Associate-Project Manager Key Projects:
GSM (Global Screening Model): Oversaw delivery of payment screening systems aligned with global compliance regulations for Anti Money Laundering, Sanctions, OFAC
Client Onboarding & KYC Platform: Delivered scalable solutions for onboarding and compliance across multiple business units.
